seo.title: About us - Test-English
seo.description: Prepare for your English exam with online grammar, listening, reading, and writing practice tailored to your level at Test-English.com.

html:
Who we are

At Test-English.com we provide everything you need to prepare for your English exam. Our platform offers online practice in the key areas essential for earning your English certificate: grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading, and writing.

We are a team of passionate English teachers and e-learning enthusiasts. Over the years, we’ve developed online materials to support students in preparing for their English exams. Our goal has always been to create a learning platform that adapts to each student’s pace, goals, abilities, schedule, and motivation.

In today’s fast-paced world, more and more people need to certify their English proficiency for professional or educational purposes. However, finding the time for English lessons can be a challenge. With Test-English.com, you can improve your skills at your own pace, all from the comfort of your home.

How It Works

  1. Start with our online level test to determine your approximate level.
  2. Based on your results, begin working on grammar and vocabulary lessons and take listening and reading tests tailored to your level.
  3. Once you’ve completed all the grammar lessons at your level, try our Use of English tests. These end-of-course grammar tests help track your progress and identify areas for improvement.

What We Offer

Clear grammar explanations and practice to test your understanding.
Hundreds of grammar exercises and tests for every level.
Grammar diagrams to help you better remember the grammar.
Three different types of exercises for each grammar point.
Feedback on every one of your answers so that you can understand and learn from your mistakes.
Complete vocabulary lessons with pictures, definitions, example sentences, exercises with personalized feedback, and games.
Listening and reading tests on current topics with feedback and/or transcriptions.
Different types of questions to test your listening and reading skills.
Instant marking.
